plugins.name: agentarium
plugins.description: Make every AI token earn its keep: automated prevention for the whole AI coding session. pennywise, the flagship, routes every prompt to the model it needs, net of what routing costs, and learns from what lands; a forward-looking band and statusline (forecast, budget or Copilot premium requests left, cache risk, the saving to make, what pennywise saved); one decision per prompt from budget, quotes and guard-rails against floods, loops, scope creep and carried context; test, build and install output strained before the model reads it; and proof: cost per result, agent forensics, a quality gate and one audit of every leak. Profiles: frugal, balanced, quality.
